title: Toolbar layout: three-dot menu leftmost in the action cluster then Column Selection; filters run date range, part search, Category, Vendor, Location
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Inventory Value report is open.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the toolbar's action cluster and read the order of its controls.
2. Read the toolbar filters from left to right.
custom_expected:
1. In the toolbar, the three-dot download menu sits leftmost in the action cluster, followed by the Column Selection control.
2. The toolbar filters run, left to right: the date-range control, the part search, the Category filter, the Vendor filter, and the Location filter (rightmost).
